text_block_list.text: The first 3 years with Yaeno Muteki have come to an end.

She was able to achieve results
in the Twinkle Series.

Through battling so many rivals,
I believe Yaeno Muteki was able to grow both in mind and body—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Seiya!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ! Master, thank you for your hard work!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
I did not realize you were here as well, Trainer.
Pardon my discourtesy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: And so, what brings you here today?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Here is my report on the Twinkle Series.
As I have now concluded my first three years.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: —I'm listening.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have approached my races with the Kongo Yaegaki style's 'Harmony of Fire and Water' as my very foundation.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, the Twinkle Series is a clash of countless rivals.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Faced with strong-willed rivals,
my fragile heart reached its limits.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, I could never bend the knee before the strong.
My passion demanded nothing less than the pinnacle."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—I want to win. I want to defeat her at the pinnacle.
I want to triumph over everyone and bask in the glory of the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Craving victory, I—...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She chose to transcend "Unity of Fire and Water," surrendering
to her fiery passion and turning her fighting spirit into pure strength.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...I have defied the teachings of the Kongo Yaegaki style, which dictate that one must suppress their desire for self-display."
However, I don't believe I was wrong. I firmly stand by the fact that it was a necessary measure to defeat my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Trainer-dono has guided me on the righteous path as my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I myself have no regrets
about unleashing my own raw passion.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However... I had hoped to have
the Grandmaster and Assistant Master
witness my growth in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...However, the reality is that I only exposed my own immaturity by failing to abandon my desire for self-display.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry for dragging
the Kongo Yaegaki name through the mud!

Having heard Yaeno Muteki's declaration, the master
sat in contemplative silence for a while.
—Eventually, he asked.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What are your thoughts, Trainer?
Do you believe Yaeno failed to grow...?
choice_data_list: I don't think so at all!!

text_block_list.text:
Over three years of running nonstop, hitting every wall imaginable,
Yaeno Muteki has continued to strive, fueled by her desire to win.

And she won. Against a field of formidable rivals.
How could one call this anything other than true growth!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
“—Agreed. Not turning away from your own weaknesses
and accepting them is also a form of growth.”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Master...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
I have watched every single one of Yaeno's races for three years.
Therefore, I also know what the source of her strength is.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
With that being said... let me say this.
You did well, Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
......!
Grandp— Master... Gr-Grandpa!!
Overcome with emotion, Yaeno Muteki dashed forward and leaped into the old man's arms with tears in her eyes—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer-dono.
Thank you for everything over these past three years.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you, Trainer, that my grandpas were able to see how much I've grown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"However... as you know,
I am still quite inexperienced.
I believe I will continue to need a guide along my path."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-dono. Will you continue
to walk alongside me from here on?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Wonderful!
I look forward to working with you for a long time to come!
